COALINDIA.notes: Net profit attributable to owners from Upstox (news summary, 29 Oct 2026); the article does not say explicitly that 15,368 is the owners' share, but it sits just below total PAT 15,397 (+19%) as 6,516 sits below 6,547, so I take it as owners'. Screener EPS: quarter 10.57 vs 6.91 (+53.0%); half-year 14.36+10.57=24.93 vs 14.27+6.91=21.18 (+17.7%). The quarter's +53% is against a weak base: July-September 2025 profit (4,259) was unusually low (Screener: 8,788 in the quarter before it). Half-year: production 321 Mt (-2%), offtake 384.2 Mt (+8%), revenue +14%. Fiscal 2026 profit had fallen (Screener: 31,071 vs 35,450 crore, EPS 50.46 vs 57.61), so current growth is partly recovery. No profit guidance found; no one-off item reported in the summaries read. Not a departure, but note: on 1 Nov 2026 the company disclosed a draft prospectus for an IPO of subsidiary SECL in which Coal India would sell up to 668,056,100 shares (Screener announcement list) - a future minority share of profit would go to outside holders. Second interim dividend 10.25 rupees (first 5.50). Company presentation on BSE could not be opened.

April-June 2026 also carried a 668 crore legal claim settlement; the company gives no adjusted six-month figure.

HINDZINC.notes: Current figures and growth percentages (+142%, +143%) as stated in news reproductions of the company's release (PSU Connect, Free Press Journal, 19 Oct 2026); year-ago values 2,649 and 4,883 (2,234+2,649) are from Screener. Screener EPS: quarter 15.18 vs 6.27, half-year 28.12 vs 11.56 (+143%). The jump is price-driven, not volume-driven: mined metal +5%, refined metal +7%, silver output +20%, while revenue rose 77%; the release attributes revenue to higher metal prices, higher output and better by-product realisation, and says silver was about 45% of half-year profit. Zinc cost of production fell 29% to 703 dollars/tonne (776 for the half-year, -23%). No price figures (LME zinc, silver) were in the pages I could open. No profit guidance found (a headline, page not opened, says the company cut its annual production cost forecast). No exceptional items reported. Nothing departed. No evidence of lasting deterioration - the opposite question applies here (commodity-price windfall). Screener shows dividend payout 0% for fiscal 2026 (118% in fiscal 2025), which may matter for the dividend yield used. Company call transcript on BSE and engineeringnews.co.za could not be opened.

departed.tr: Otelcilik işi 1 Ocak 2025'te ayrı şirkete (ITC Hotels) devredildi. Mart 2025 yılının konsolide net kârı (35.052 crore rupi) Mart 2026 yılınınkinden (21.018 crore rupi) çok yüksek; fark durdurulan faaliyetlerden geliyor: 15.016 crore rupi, büyük bölümü ayrılmada yazılan değerleme kazancı. Sürdürülen faaliyetlerin kârı 20.036 crore rupiden 21.018 crore rupiye çıktı.
departed.en: The hotels business was demerged into a separate company (ITC Hotels) on 1 January 2025. Consolidated net profit for the year to March 2025 (35,052 crore rupees) is far above the year to March 2026 (21,018 crore rupees); the gap comes from discontinued operations: 15,016 crore rupees, most of it the fair-value gain booked on the demerger. Profit from continuing operations rose from 20,036 to 21,018 crore rupees.
departed.basis_tr: Kalan işin büyümesi bulunamadı. Son iki dönem karşılaştırmasının iki yanında da otel yok.
departed.basis_en: Growth of the remaining business not found. Hotels are in neither side of the latest period comparisons.

permanent.tr: Sigarada vergi 1 Şubat 2026'da kalıcı olarak arttı; şirket bunu "benzeri görülmemiş vergi artışı" diye anıyor ve hacmin kaçak sigaraya kayma riskinden söz ediyor (Nisan-Haziran 2026 basın açıklaması). Sigara kolunun kârı Temmuz-Eylül 2026'da %27,2 düştü (3.813 crore rupi; bir yıl önce 5.241). Yasal değişiklik sürüyor; şirket bir toparlanma tarihi vermiyor.
permanent.en: Cigarette taxes rose permanently on 1 February 2026; the company calls it an "unprecedented increase in tax" and cites the risk of volume moving to illicit trade (April-June 2026 press release). Cigarette segment profit fell 27.2% in July-September 2026 (3,813 crore rupees; 5,241 a year earlier). The law remains in force; the company gives no recovery date.
